name: Jabez
bio: Jabez, of the tribe of Judah, was more honorable than his brothers; his mother named him Jabez, meaning "he causes pain," because she bore him in sorrow. Jabez prayed to the God of Israel, "Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me!" And God granted him what he asked (1 Chronicles 4:9-10).
